name: Command Palette
hint: Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K, or click the trigger. Type to filter.
description: ⌘K search-and-jump palette with fuzzy matching, highlighted letters, grouped results and keyboard-first navigation. Takes your commands as groups of items, a controlled open state and query, server results with a loading state, and a global shortcut you choose. The active row slides between results instead of jumping.
usage: Mount once near the app root. Pass `groups` as [{ id, label, items: [{ id, label, icon, shortcut, keywords, disabled, onSelect }] }] and handle `onSelect(item, group)`; the palette closes on select unless `closeOnSelect` is false. It opens from its own search button and the global `shortcut` ("mod+k": ⌘K on a Mac, Ctrl+K elsewhere; pass another combo or false). Control it with `open` / `onOpenChange` and pass `trigger` for your own button (opened by state with no `trigger`, it shows no button). For server results, pass `query` / `onQueryChange`, `shouldFilter={false}` and `loading`. Keep labels short; the fuzzy match rewards word starts.

dataProps.description: [{ id, label, items: [{ id, label, icon, shortcut, keywords, disabled, onSelect, closeOnSelect }] }]. label is a string; shortcut a string ("G D") or array of keys shown on the row; keywords extra words that match. `name` (group) and `hint` (item) still work. Empty by default.
(item, group) => void when an item is chosen (Enter or click), after the item's own onSelect. Not called for disabled items.
Close after a choice. An item's own closeOnSelect wins.
Controlled open state. Leave undefined to let the palette manage itself.
Open on mount when uncontrolled.
(open: boolean, reason) => void. reason: "trigger", "shortcut", "select", "escape", "outside" or "button" (the phone Cancel button).

Global key that toggles the palette: true is "mod+k" (⌘ or Ctrl, shown as ⌘K on Apple keyboards and Ctrl K elsewhere), a string such as "ctrl+shift+p" or "/" (a bare key is ignored while typing in a field), or false for none.
Controlled search text. Use with onQueryChange to load results as the user types.
Starting search text when uncontrolled (cleared each time the palette opens).
(query: string) => void on every keystroke.
(item, query) => boolean | number. Replaces the built-in fuzzy match: false or 0 hides an item, true or a number keeps it, higher numbers first.
false shows groups exactly as given (your server already filtered them); no highlighting.
Your own loading flag while results load: placeholder rows when there are none yet, a spinner in the field when there are.
Your own error message when results failed to load; shown in place of the list (role=alert). Results you still pass are hidden while it is set.
() => void. With error set, adds a Try again button; Enter in the field calls it too.
Shown when nothing matches. A string, a node or (query) => node. Default: "No results" (with the query when there is one).
(item, { active, query }) => node. Replaces the row's content (icon, label, shortcut); the row keeps its option role, keyboard and click behaviour.
Placeholder and accessible name of the search field; also the built-in trigger's text unless triggerLabel is set.
Text of the built-in trigger button. Defaults to the placeholder.
Accessible name of the dialog.

Your own trigger: an element (cloned with a ref, onClick and aria attributes) or (props) => node spreading { ref, onClick, aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, disabled }. Left out, the built-in search button shows unless you pass `open`. null renders none.
Show the built-in search button (when uncontrolled and no trigger is passed).
The keyboard hints and result count under the list (hidden on phones).
Escape closes the palette.
A press on the backdrop closes the palette.

Where focus goes on close: a ref, an element, a CSS selector or a function returning one. Default: the trigger, else what had focus before opening, else the control nearest to it. false leaves focus alone.
Disables the trigger and the shortcut.
Fill the palette with the gallery's sample commands when no groups are passed.
The dialog panel (null while closed). className, style and other props go to it too.

example:
<CommandPalette
  groups={[
    { id: "go", label: "Go to", items: [
      { id: "orders", label: "Orders", icon: "box", shortcut: "G O", keywords: ["sales"] },
      { id: "settings", label: "Settings", icon: "settings" },
    ] },
    { id: "act", label: "Actions", items: [
      { id: "new", label: "New invoice", icon: "plus", onSelect: () => createInvoice() },
    ] },
  ]}
  onSelect={(item) => navigate(item.id)}
/>

{/* opened by state, no built-in button, results from your server */}
<CommandPalette
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  shortcut="mod+k"
  query={query}
  onQueryChange={setQuery}
  shouldFilter={false}
  loading={searching}
  groups={[{ id: "people", label: "People", items: people.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, label: p.name, icon: "user" })) }]}
  emptyMessage={(q) => (q ? `Nobody called "${q}"` : "Type a name")}
  onSelect={(item) => openProfile(item.id)}
/>
